LEUCOCYTE (WBC) TAXONOMY
                                       │
         ┌─────────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────┐
         ▼                                                           ▼
    GRANULOCYTES                                               AGRANULOCYTES
(Lobulated Nuclei + Cytoplasmic Granules)                  (Non-Lobulated Nuclei + No Granules)
 ├── Neutrophils (60–65% - Phagocytic)                      ├── Lymphocytes (20–25% - Immune)
 ├── Eosinophils (2–3% - Allergies/Parasites)               └── Monocytes (6–8% - Macrophages)
 └── Basophils (0.5–1% - Histamine/Heparin)
conceptBreakdown.content:
### Formed Elements Diagnostic Matrix

| Cell Type | Abundance / Count | Morphological & Nuclear Characteristics | Primary Physiological Role |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Erythrocytes (RBCs)** | $5.0\text{--}5.5\text{ Million/mm}^3$ | Biconcave, enucleated at maturity (lacks mitochondria and ER), non-motile; lifespan $\approx 120\text{ days}$ | Transports $\text{O}_2$ and $\text{CO}_2$ via Hemoglobin ($12\text{--}16\text{ g/100 mL}$); destroyed in Spleen ("Graveyard of RBCs") |
| **Neutrophils** | $60\text{--}65\%$ of WBCs | Multilobed nucleus ($3\text{--}5$ lobes); neutral-staining granules | Polymorphonuclear (PMN) **phagocytes**; first responders to bacterial infections |
| **Eosinophils** | $2\text{--}3\%$ of WBCs | Bilobed nucleus; coarse acidophilic granules staining bright pink/red with Eosin | Resists parasitic infections (*helminths*); mediates allergic hypersensitivity reactions |
| **Basophils** | $0.5\text{--}1\%$ of WBCs | S-shaped / 3-lobed nucleus; coarse basophilic granules staining blue/purple | Secretes **Histamine** (vasodilator), **Serotonin** (vasoconstrictor), and **Heparin** (anticoagulant); mediates inflammation |
| **Monocytes** | $6\text{--}8\%$ of WBCs | Kidney-shaped / Horseshoe-shaped nucleus; abundant agranular cytoplasm | Largest WBC; transforms into tissue **Macrophages** (*e.g., Kupffer cells, Microglia*) for phagocytosis |
| **Lymphocytes** | $20\text{--}25\%$ of WBCs | Large spherical nucleus surrounded by a thin rim of cytoplasm | **B-Lymphocytes** (humoral immunity) and **T-Lymphocytes** (cell-mediated immunity) |
| **Thrombocytes (Platelets)** | $1.5\text{--}3.5\text{ Lakhs/mm}^3$ | Enucleated cell fragments derived from bone marrow **Megakaryocytes**; lifespan $\approx 7\text{--}10\text{ days}$ | Initiates blood clotting by releasing **Thromboplastin** and vasoconstrictor **Serotonin** |
